notes: Dockerfile.final uses python:3.11-slim base with apt-get for system packages. setup_runtime.sh installs PyTorch from CPU-only index (https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cpu). repo_setup.sh materializes /workspace from git at build time. eval.sh and test assets are runtime-mounted, not baked into image. Final WORKDIR is /workspace. All COPY sources exist in build context.
